mh_burst_pipe.text: You wake up to the sound of a waterfall in your wall. A pipe has burst and the hallway is now a pond.

outcomes.diy_ok: A video tutorial and sheer spite fix it. You are very proud.
outcomes.diy_worse: You make it worse. Much worse. The ceiling downstairs joins the party.

mh_roof_leak.text: Rain is dripping into a bucket in your living room. The roof has been lying to you for years.

mh_hoa_fight.text: The homeowners' committee sends a stern letter about the colour of your front door. It is, apparently, a crime.

outcomes.fight_win: You win at the meeting with a twelve-minute speech. The door stays. Legends are born.
outcomes.fight_lose: You lose, pay the legal fees, and the door is beige now.

mh_nosy_neighbour.text: Your neighbour knows when you leave, when you return, and what was in your recycling. Today they ask about last night.

outcomes.bait_fun: By Friday the whole street believes you run an alpaca farm. Worth it.
outcomes.bait_caught: They find out. Now the whole street whispers louder.

mh_squatter.text: You find a stranger living in your spare room. He has made himself tea and is wearing your robe.

outcomes.talk_leaves: He cries, apologises, and leaves quietly. You give him a sandwich.
outcomes.talk_steals: He agrees to leave and takes your television as a goodbye gift.
outcomes.bat_run: He runs out through the window. You feel like an action hero.
outcomes.bat_hurt: It goes badly. Someone gets hurt, and it is mostly you.

mh_tree_falls.text: A storm drops an old oak across your garage. The car is fine. The garage is now a sunroof.

outcomes.insurance_paid: The insurer pays most of it after three months and fourteen forms.
outcomes.insurance_denied: Claim denied: 'act of nature'. You point out that is the whole point of insurance.

mh_break_in.text: You come home to an open window and a missing TV. Whoever it was also took the good whisky.

choices.stakeout: Set a trap for next time

outcomes.report_caught: Surprisingly, they catch the thief and you get most of it back.
outcomes.report_nothing: The officer nods sadly and writes 'burglary' on a form. That is all.
outcomes.stakeout_win: He comes back. You are waiting with a flashlight and a rolling pin. Neighbours applaud.
outcomes.stakeout_lose: Nobody comes, and you fall asleep. Next night, they take the sofa.

mh_flood.text: A river decides your street is its new route. Water is rising up your stairs.

outcomes.claim_covered: The policy actually covers flood. You nearly faint from joy.
outcomes.claim_not: The fine print says 'excludes water'. The water read it too.
outcomes.sandbag_hold: The whole street joins in. The water stops at your doorstep.
outcomes.sandbag_fail: The sandbags float away like little regrets.

mh_reno_pays.text: You finally gut the kitchen. An agent walks through and whistles at the new price.

outcomes.go_great: It looks like a magazine. You cook twice in one week to celebrate.
outcomes.go_meh: The contractor vanishes halfway. The tiles are crooked and so is your mood.

mh_noisy_reno.text: Next door starts a renovation. Drilling begins at 7 a.m. and apparently never ends.

outcomes.complain_stops: Inspectors cut their hours. Quiet afternoons return.
outcomes.complain_feud: The neighbours find out who complained. Cold war begins.

mh_haunted_rumour.text: A kid on your street says your house is haunted. By Tuesday strangers are photographing the porch.

outcomes.embrace_boom: Ten dollars a head. Ghosts have never been this profitable.
outcomes.embrace_flop: Only your aunt buys a ticket, and she wants a refund.
outcomes.sleep_fine: Nothing happens, except the fridge hums in B-flat.
outcomes.sleep_scary: Something knocks. You choose not to investigate and sleep in the car.

mh_wildfire.text: The sky turns orange. An evacuation order comes at 3 a.m. You have ten minutes.

outcomes.leave_saved: The house survives with scorched shutters. A hotel bill later, life goes on.
outcomes.leave_lost: The house burns. You watch the news from a stranger's sofa.
outcomes.leave_died: You hesitate too long, and the road is gone.
outcomes.hose_hero: You save the house, and your eyebrows regret it.
outcomes.hose_fail: The wind changes. You barely run out.

mh_termites.text: A strange tapping comes from the walls. A pest man cuts into a beam and it crumbles like cake.

outcomes.spot_ok: It works. The termites move next door.
outcomes.spot_bad: They were only getting started. The floor goes.

mh_property_tax.text: The city reassesses your house. The new property tax bill makes you check the zeros twice.

outcomes.appeal_win: The board agrees the 'sea view' is a parking lot. Bill reduced.
outcomes.appeal_lose: Appeal rejected, plus a filing fee.

mh_garden_gnome_war.text: Someone keeps swapping your garden flowers for plastic ones. A cold war with a retired neighbour begins.

outcomes.escalate_win: You win by planting one perfect rose. They surrender.
outcomes.escalate_lose: They answer with a fountain. You lose by a mile.

mh_rats_attic.text: Scratching in the attic. By night you have named the rats.

outcomes.traps_ok: You catch two and become a quiet hunter of the night.
outcomes.traps_snap: The trap catches your finger. The rats look unimpressed.

mh_solar_roof.text: A salesman offers solar panels. He promises your electric bill will drop to zero and pay you back.

outcomes.buy_good: The bills do shrink. The sun is finally working for you.
outcomes.buy_scam: The company vanishes after the first payment. Three panels sit on your roof, looking sad.

mh_basement_find.text: Behind a loose panel in the basement you find an old tin box.

outcomes.open_cash: Old banknotes, still good. Someone forgot a fortune.
outcomes.open_photos: Photos of strangers in funny hats. A mystery for another day.
outcomes.open_bad: Mould, mice and one very old sandwich.

mh_heat_wave_ac.text: A heat wave hits and your air conditioner dies with a sad sigh. The repair shop quotes you a price.

mh_mortgage_refi.text: The bank calls with a 'special offer' to refinance your mortgage. The rate seems too good.

outcomes.accept_saves: You do save thousands. Nobody is more surprised than you.
outcomes.accept_fees: Closing costs eat every saving for the next ten years.

mh_rent_hike.text: The landlord emails: rent is going up 20 percent. 'Market conditions', he says. He just bought a boat.

outcomes.negotiate_half: He settles on a smaller rise after you mention the broken heater.
outcomes.negotiate_no: He laughs. The email ends with a smiley face.

mh_landlord_enters.text: You come home and find your landlord in your kitchen, 'just checking the pipes'. He is eating your yogurt.

outcomes.confront_stops: You quote the lease. He apologises and gives you a pie.
outcomes.confront_anger: He says you're 'not a team player' and raises the rent a bit.

mh_deposit_theft.text: You move out spotless. The landlord keeps your whole deposit for 'wear and tear', whatever that means.

outcomes.court_win: The judge reads your photos like scripture. You get it all back.
outcomes.court_lose: You lose and pay the fee. The judge shrugs.

mh_eviction_notice.text: A paper is taped to your door: you have 30 days to leave. The reason is a typo.

outcomes.fight_stay: The court finds the notice invalid. You stay, and the landlord sulks.
outcomes.fight_lose: The judge gives you thirty days and a sympathetic look.

mh_roommate_dishes.text: Your roommate's dishes have formed a culture in the sink. A tiny civilisation has started.

outcomes.talk_fixed: They say sorry and wash everything. For a week.
outcomes.talk_blow: The talk becomes a fight about everything since 2019.

mh_roommate_rent.text: Your roommate says they'll 'definitely have the rent next week'. This is the third week they say it.

outcomes.kick_ok: They leave quietly and even leave a thank-you note.
outcomes.kick_revenge: They leave and take the toaster and the good lamp.

mh_roommate_party.text: You come home from a long shift to find fifty strangers in the living room and your roommate on the table.

outcomes.join_fun: Best night of the year. You meet a great person in the kitchen.
outcomes.join_trouble: Police arrive. Someone breaks the window and you pay for it.

mh_mold_flat.text: There's black mould in your bathroom, and it is starting to look like a map of Europe.

outcomes.landlord_fixed: He sends someone who scrubs it. The mould returns in a month.
outcomes.landlord_ignored: No reply. The cough starts around the second week.

mh_noisy_upstairs.text: The people upstairs seem to be practising dance every night at midnight. Plaster rains from your ceiling.

outcomes.knock_nice: They are lovely, apologise, and invite you to dinner.
outcomes.knock_rude: They slam the door and play louder out of spite.

mh_landlord_sells.text: Your landlord tells you the building is sold. The new owner wants it empty by spring.

outcomes.buyout_paid: They pay you to go. Your first paycheck for doing nothing.
outcomes.buyout_nothing: They laugh and send a cleaning bill.

mh_tax_audit.text: A letter from the tax office: you are being audited. Bring receipts for the last three years.

outcomes.honest_clean: Everything checks out. The auditor tips his hat.
outcomes.honest_small: They find a small error. You pay, sign, and breathe.
outcomes.honest_big: A big mistake from five years ago. Ouch.
outcomes.hide_lucky: They give up after a month of silence.
outcomes.hide_caught: They find everything, with a fine and a file for the prosecutor.

mh_bank_error.text: You check your account. The bank has added $9,000 by mistake. No one has called yet.

outcomes.keep_ok: Nobody notices. You still feel a tiny itch at night.
outcomes.keep_caught: The bank notices, takes it back, and adds a fee.

mh_identity_theft.text: A bank calls: someone just opened three cards in your name. They bought a very expensive blender.

outcomes.fight_cleared: Weeks of calls, but the debts are wiped.
outcomes.fight_stuck: The credit damage sticks. You become a security expert out of spite.

mh_tax_refund.text: The tax office actually owes YOU money. A refund of $1,800 appears in your account.

choices.gamble: Put it all on a bet

outcomes.gamble_win: Double or nothing: double. You walk like a king.
outcomes.gamble_lose: Nothing. The refund was a rumour.

mh_crypto_tip.text: {{name}} whispers that a new coin is 'about to explode'. They've already put their rent in.

outcomes.invest_moon: It goes to the moon. {{name}} sends a rocket emoji and a fruit basket.
outcomes.invest_zero: The coin collapses overnight. {{name}} stops answering.

mh_mlm_pitch.text: An old acquaintance invites you for coffee, then pulls out a whiteboard. It is a pyramid, but 'a friendly one'.

choices.expose: Call it a scam out loud

outcomes.join_small: You sell enough to break even and keep a decade of leggings.
outcomes.join_loss: Your garage is full of unsold shakes. Your friends avoid you.

mh_lottery_pool.text: The office starts a lottery pool. Everyone puts in $10. Jackpots have been sad lately.

outcomes.join_win: The pool wins! Your share is $20,000 and a new reason to be careful what you say to coworkers.

mh_late_paycheck.text: Payday comes and nothing arrives. HR sends an email with the subject 'Oops'.

outcomes.push_paid: They pay in two days with a small apology bonus.
outcomes.push_tense: They pay, but your manager is cold for a month.

mh_inheritance_scam.text: An email: a distant prince in a distant land left you $4 million. They just need a small fee.

mh_forgotten_sub.text: You find a subscription you forgot about. It has been charging you for years. For a gym in another city.

outcomes.fight_refund: They refund the whole year. You frame the email.
outcomes.fight_no: Customer service puts you on hold until the heat death of the universe.

mh_parking_ticket.text: A parking ticket sits under your wiper. You parked in front of a sign that says, in small letters, 'not here'.

outcomes.appeal_win: Cancelled. Your smugness lasts all week.

mh_car_impound.text: You walk out and your car is gone. A sign says it was towed to a lot across the city.

outcomes.argue_win: You win a discount after a dramatic speech.
outcomes.argue_lose: He adds a 'drama fee'. It is not on the sign.

mh_investment_pitch.text: A smooth man in a nice shirt offers you 'guaranteed returns'. He doesn't say the word 'risk'.

outcomes.invest_ok: A real return, to your own astonishment.
outcomes.invest_scam: He vanishes. So does the office.

mh_medical_bill.text: A surprise medical bill arrives for a visit you thought was covered. The total has commas.

outcomes.negotiate_cut: They cut it by two thirds after one email. Why not earlier?
outcomes.negotiate_same: No change, but they offer a payment plan.

mh_windfall_sale.text: You find an old guitar in the attic. A collector says it is worth real money.

outcomes.sell_good: $3,000 for something you were going to throw away.
outcomes.sell_fake: It's a fake. He still offers $50 for the fun of it.

mh_gold_digger.text: A stunning stranger laughs at all your jokes. They ask about your 'portfolio' before your name.

outcomes.test_stays: They stay anyway. You may have found something real.
outcomes.test_leaves: They vanish before dessert. Mystery solved.

mh_charity_gala.text: You are invited to a charity gala. The tickets are $10,000. The chicken is awful.

outcomes.attend_deal: A tipsy investor hands you a very good business card.
outcomes.attend_flop: You buy a silent-auction painting of a duck for $3,000.

mh_kidnap_threat.text: An anonymous note says they know your routine. They want $200,000 or they 'take someone close'.

outcomes.police_caught: They trace the note to a bitter ex-employee. You sigh in relief.
outcomes.police_real: They threaten again and you pay for round-the-clock guards.

mh_advisor_fraud.text: Your financial advisor has been in your accounts for years. He's gone, and so is a big part of your fortune.

outcomes.sue_recover: The court finds most of it. You pay the lawyers.
outcomes.sue_lost: He is in another country. The money is in another dimension.

mh_yacht_party.text: A friend lends you a yacht for the weekend. By Saturday you're hosting fifty people and a DJ.

outcomes.party_great: Legendary weekend. Photos are never discussed.
outcomes.party_disaster: Someone sinks the dinghy and the friend's lawyers call.

mh_tax_haven.text: A smooth lawyer offers to move your money to a sunny island where nobody asks questions. Nobody pays tax, either.

outcomes.accept_saves: Your tax bill shrinks by a huge amount. Your conscience, a little less.
outcomes.accept_caught: A leak names you in a famous list. A fine and a scandal follow.

mh_family_house.text: Your cousin asks you for a house. 'You have so many,' they say, kindly. They have never paid anything back.

outcomes.loan_paid: They actually pay it back, with interest, and a pie.
outcomes.loan_never: The loan becomes a family legend of ingratitude.

mh_paparazzi_house.text: A drone hovers over your pool. Your private life is now a headline.

outcomes.sue_win: They settle for a sum and a retraction.
outcomes.sue_lose: A judge calls it 'public interest'. Ouch.

mh_art_buy.text: A gallery owner offers you a painting for $25,000. 'It's an investment,' she says, near a painting of a banana.

outcomes.buy_grows: The artist becomes famous. Your banana is a masterpiece.
outcomes.buy_flat: It hangs in your hallway. Guests politely look away.

mh_inheritance_fight.text: Your relatives suddenly remember you exist. All of them want a share of your 'generous heart'.

outcomes.party_good: The dinner is warm, loud and surprisingly honest.
outcomes.party_bad: Three fights, one thrown pie, and a vow to never meet again.
